patthana18.5:1.1: hetuṃ āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu no āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca.
patthana18.5:2.1: hetuṃ noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca. hetuduka sāsavaduke nahetuduka nasāsavadukaṃ
patthana18.5:3.1: nahetuṃ sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.5:4.1: hetuṃ anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. hetuduka āsavasampayuttaduke nahetuduka naāsavasampayuttadukaṃ
patthana18.5:5.1: hetuṃ āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava.
patthana18.5:6.1: hetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. hetuduka āsavasāsavaduke nahetuduka naāsavasāsavadukaṃ
patthana18.5:7.1: hetuṃ āsavañcevasāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na āsavoceva na anāsavoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca.
patthana18.5:8.1: hetuṃ sāsavañceva nocaāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na anāsavoceva na nocaāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca. hetuduka āsavaāsavasampayuttaduke nahetuduka naāsavaāsavasampayuttadukaṃ
patthana18.5:9.1: hetuṃ āsavañceva āsavasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na āsavoceva na āsavavippayuttoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.5:10.1: nahetuṃ āsavasampayuttañceva nocaāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na āsavavippayuttoceva na nocaāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. hetuduka āsavavippayuttasāsavaduke nahetuduka āsavavippayuttanasāsavadukaṃ
patthana18.5:11.1: nahetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu āsavavippayutto na sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: lokiyasadisaṃ.
patthana18.5:12.1: hetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu āsavavippayutto na anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: nahetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu āsavavippayutto na anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: hetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavañca nahetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu āsavavippayutto na anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana18.5:13.1: hetuyā tīṇi. hetuduka saññojanagocchakaduke nahetuduka nosaññojanagocchakadukaṃ
